## Shared context (verbatim, immutable)

# Review Context (generated by llm-review-bench)

This file is immutable for this run. Every reviewer receives the same case facts and no
access to gold labels, other reviewer output, or adjudication records.

## 1. Objective

docs: bound llm-ledger archiving to sanitized audit records

MUST: archive review runs as audit records only — exclude logs/, agent-output/,
and snapshot/, which carry raw model output that the benchmark security
boundary forbids committing, or a nested worktree — and archive the matching
.review-benchmark/gold/<run-id>/ so report and rescore still recompute from the
archive.
MUST: stage and push from a dedicated ledger worktree after fetching
origin/llm-ledger, creating the branch from an orphan root only when absent;
on non-fast-forward rejection rebase onto the fetched tip and retry; remove
the delivery worktree only once the pushed tip contains the topic.
MUST NOT: commit raw reviewer logs or agent output to any branch, or drop the
gold tree from the archive.

Addresses the first two review rounds: raw-log security conflict, missing
gold, missing append protocol, git-ignored staging, and the omitted
ledger-checkout step.

summary: The change rewrites the llm-ledger archiving instructions across four documentation files to exclude raw model output (logs/, agent-output/, snapshot/) and to archive matching gold, and to stage/push from a dedicated ledger worktree with an orphan-root fallback, fetch-rebase retry, and a post-push cleanup guard. I verified the key operational claims against the actual CLI: `tools/llm-review-bench`'s `report`/`rescore` only read `inputs/`, `reviews/`, `derived/`, `reports/`, `gold/`, `run.json`, `state.json`, and `events.jsonl`, so the `--output <ledger-checkout>/<topic>` benchmark-root claim is correct and the `snapshot/` exclusion does not break recomputation. The only defect found is a contract drift in review.md, whose rewritten parenthetical omits the `snapshot/` exclusion that the other three files and the change's own MUST all require.

findings.title: review.md omits snapshot/ from the archive exclusion list
findings.trigger: A delivering agent follows the Independent Review Procedure summary in review.md and archives a run directory, excluding only raw logs and agent output, and copies `.review-benchmark/runs/<run-id>` wholesale into `<topic>/runs/<run-id>` including the nested `snapshot/` worktree.
findings.consequence: The nested `snapshot/` worktree is staged and committed; git records it as a gitlink (a submodule-style reference to a commit that is not a real submodule), producing a broken reference in the llm-ledger branch or a failed commit/push, which violates the change's MUST to exclude the nested worktree.
findings.evidence: review.md:64-65 reads "delivery commits its audit records (raw logs and agent output excluded)", omitting the snapshot; workflow.md:24-27, verification/delivery-ledger.md:15-16, and design/llm-review-benchmark.md:319-320 all explicitly exclude `snapshot/`, so the summary diverges from the canonical instruction.
findings.suggestedFix: Add the snapshot to the parenthetical in review.md, e.g., "delivery commits its audit records (raw logs, agent output, and the nested snapshot excluded)", so the summary matches workflow.md and the change's own MUST.
